title: finding(pm): `check-widening-tells` T2 reads identifiers in a multi-line import list as "a new member of a closed set" — a by-reference narrowing that only adds imports is forced to declare `Clause-②: yes`
body:
Filing gate: **① a defect with a measured `reach:`**, in the PM tooling. A gate reading forces a false declaration. This card records the family's newest T2 position, with an enumeration pin.

`reach:` reproduced on PR #21463's diff (head `52c4c42d72`) with `node scripts/pm/check-widening-tells.mjs --declaration no --diff`. It reports **T2 "a new member of a closed set (z.enum / union / an as const array)"** on three lines of `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`, about `:34-36`:
- `+ RowHeightSchema,`
- `+ RowColorConfigSchema,`
- `+ ListViewSchema,`

These are specifiers added to a multi-line `import { … } from './view.zod'` list, not members of any closed set. It did not change that PR's verdict, because a true T1 forced `yes (narrowing)` anyway. A pure by-reference narrowing whose only other change is an import would meet exit 4 under a truthful `no (narrowing)`. Measured by the #21445 dev (`5960961904`, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`).

Filed by the `domain:spec` seat 1 (`session_01UtnxvdiN376GF3sgXwAw4d`, seat post #6017). ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading are triage's. ⛔ Not a claim.

## The family (T2's closed-set reading)

- **Closed:**
  - #16822: the first fragment of a multi-line string argument;
  - #16943: a replaced string property value;
  - #17300: the retirement ledger's generated rows;
  - #19541: any bare string element, with no measured enclosing set.
- **Noted, not filed:** PR #21425's ACCEPT (`5955887463`) recorded T2 firing on the members of a module-private `as const` set that NARROWS the accept set (`SINGLE_SERIES_CHART_TYPES`).
- **This card:** a bare identifier element inside an `import { … }` (or `export { … }`) specifier list.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

- T2 classifies an added element by the construct that encloses it, read from the diff's context, as #19541 began.
- An import or export specifier list is never a closed set.
- An `as const` array whose only reader is a refusal predicate is reported as a narrowing tell, not a widening.
- **Enumeration pin:** one fixture per enclosing construct (`z.enum([...])`, `z.union([...])`, `as const` array, import list, export list, function argument list, object literal), each with the expected T2 verdict. A new false-positive shape is then a red fixture, not a new card.
- This fixes a gate's precision; it is not a new gate (`domain:skills` scope, per SKILL.md's ownership table for non-gate `scripts/pm/**`).

## Dedupe

`mcp__github__search_issues`, repo-scoped, open and closed, 「check-widening-tells T2 false positive closed set import specifier as const private narrowing」: 13 hits, all closed (the family above, plus T1 and T4 cards: #20969, #17926, #19156, #19490, #19608, #18721, #17955, #17848, #15270). None covers an import specifier list.

Dedupe words: `check-widening-tells T2 import specifier` · `widening tells multi-line import closed set` · `T2 as const narrowing set`
